info.album: What I Am - Live At The Tower Theatre, Houston Tx May 3, 1989 (Remastered)

podcast.body: Lauryn Hill subtly interpolated this 1989 hit into Aretha Franklin's 1998 song "A Rose Is Still A Rose," with Hill herself singing the interpolation to make it noticeable. "Edie Brickell and Newbohemian's 1989 hit What I Am."
